items.html: And when it rose in the will of the Emanator to emanate the world of Nekudim, it was already explained above that Adam Kadmon restricted himself a second time and raised the internality of the light from half of his Tifferet and below, and raised it upward; and afterward that light came out through the eyes and spread outside, from half of his Tifferet and below, and became the world of Nekudim.
